segments.text: Lightning hits this park ranger. Then it hits him again. And again. Seven times.
No chance. Not seven. Let's go look.
Virginia, {1942|nineteen forty-two}. Ranger Roy Sullivan runs from a fire tower in a storm. The bolt takes a toenail.
{1969|Nineteen sixty-nine}. In his truck. There go his eyebrows. A year on, his own front yard. His shoulder.
{1972|Nineteen seventy-two}. Inside the ranger station. His hair catches fire. Next year, it burns again. He douses it with the water can from his truck.
{1976|Nineteen seventy-six}. His ankle. Then number {7|seven} finds him fishing. Chest and stomach, burned.
Seven strikes. He lives through every one. Guinness lists them all. Nobody on record has survived more.
Two of his scorched hats went on display. I was wrong. Case closed.
